notes: Exclusion reason function (Step 1, item 5): the learned method solves positioning/tracking, an excluded function. p. 1: "RIS-aided multi-band ISAC systems can potentially track users' positions with high precision"; p. 5: "it employs tracking function f to process J and obtains an estimated UE track"; p. 9: the MLP position regressor maps features "to the estimated UE position".
